references.text: The instruction that the people should shout when they heard the trumpet signal, which is fulfilled in verse 20.
Joshua's command for the people to shout, which is carried out in verse 20.
Hebrews refers to how the walls of Jericho fell by faith after the Israelites had marched around the city for seven days.
Instructions to blow trumpets when Israel goes to war against enemies, as happened at Jericho.
Gideon's victory over the Midianites using horns and shouts, a similar pattern to the fall of Jericho.
The Israelites shouted with a great cry of joy when the ark of the covenant came into the camp, similar to the great shout at Jericho.
Rahab's confession that the people of Jericho feared Israel, which was confirmed when the walls fell.
